name: Hana Materials Inc.
summary: Hana Materials Inc. is a South Korean enterprise primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of silicon electrodes and rings. Their diverse product lineup also encompasses silicon ceramic components, ingots, and various other specialized parts. Additionally, the company actively develops, produces, and markets materials for secondary batteries, and provides comprehensive integrated system solutions to its clients. Established in 2007 as Hana Silicon Co., Ltd., the firm rebranded to its current name, Hana Materials Inc., in May 2013. The company's main office is located in Cheonan-si, South Korea, and it functions as a subsidiary of HANA Micron Inc.
